title: Makes a perfect loaf of bread. It is a square bread.
text: Makes a perfect loaf of bread. It is a square bread.. This bread machine works great!  It was easy to use and cleans easily.  Follow instructions and your bread should come out perfectly.  I did choose a lighter bread for my gluten free Pamela's products bread and the top was a little light, but the rest was perfectly light brown.  I recommend this machines.  I made one loaf so far.
